Janet Carroll Estate Agents are delighted to offer this superb A3 rated end of terrace family home built in 2018, Approx.192sqm/2066 sq.ft for sale by private treaty.

Built to the highest building standards, this stunning property is nestled in a beautifully matured development in a super prime residential location of South County Dublin. Close to Dundrum and Stillorgan Village, providing convenient access to an array of amenities including a very wide choice of National, Private and International schools. 

Special Features:
High energy efficiency home: A3	
Prime Residential location: Close to so many amenities 				
Exceptional Schools: Enjoy a great choice of highly regarded schools, ensuring quality education for your family both private and public. Close to Wesley College,   
Shopping Facilities: Experience premier shopping at Dundrum Town Centre, featuring high-end retailers and various dining options, alongside the charming local shops in Stillorgan Village.
Medical Centres: Access to excellent healthcare services and medical clinics nearby.
Superb Transport Links: Benefit from incredible public transport options, including the LUAS for quick and easy journeys to Dublin city centre.
Close to the M50: For swift access to many locations including the Sandyford Business Park, the new College for Dentistry.
 
Property Features:

Set Back from the Main Road: Enjoy tranquillity and privacy in this home that is tastefully set back from busy thoroughfares.

Low Maintenance Red Brick Façade: The attractive and durable exterior provides both style and ease of care.

South Facing Rear Garden: Revel in sunny afternoons and outdoor gatherings in your beautifully landscaped, private garden.

Immaculate Interiors: The property is presented in immaculate condition throughout, showcasing high-quality finishes that exemplify refined living. The thoughtful design and attention to detail create an inviting ambiance perfect for families or professionals.

Included: As a bonus, the sale includes all the fitted carpets, curtains, blinds, light fitting (Living room and dining area specifically excluded) and kitchen appliance as stated, making it easy to move in and begin enjoying your new home immediately.

Why Choose This Home? This exceptional A2 rated residence combines the best of luxury living with a prime location in one of Dublin's most desirable areas. Move-in ready, it is the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience—ideal for anyone seeking a vibrant lifestyle amidst a welcoming community.
